title: Love Andy’s toys!
body:
Love ‘em all, caught them all. 💖💕

But honestly, habits not syncing between devices in ‘25 is a quite not-so-good-looking bummer, innit? Thought it was me running off the old asylum grounds here. Not nice, you! Not nice.

Please add it, so us old, you know 25+ aged people can keep our minds reasonably intact. I know the ‘intact’ is a bit of a stretch but I think you got the essence, yeah?

Have a good one!
author: i<3nature

title: Pricing
body: Their apps are super unique and fun to use but it’s a monthly/yearly subscription. If there was a fairly priced one time purchase then I’d instantly give this 5 stars
author: nickeno
